svg.title: SONiC architecture: containers around Redis databases, SAI, Spectrum ASIC
svg.text: SONiC architecture: containers around Redis databases, SAI, Spectrum ASIC
Every daemon reads/writes Redis tables; orchagent (swss) turns APPL_DB intent into SAI objects in ASIC_DB; syncd calls NVIDIA's Spectrum SAI
database container — Redis (keyspace notifications = pub/sub between daemons)

g.title: swss container — Switch State Service
g.text: (rejects on table full / unresolved next hop)

g.title: syncd container
g.text: syncd + NVIDIA Spectrum SAI library (on the SDK)

g.title: Spectrum ASIC (SN2000 – SN5000)
g.text: SAI = vendor-neutral C API; NVIDIA supplies the Spectrum implementation

svg.text: Troubleshooting rule: 'route exists but does not forward'
→ name the whiteboard it is missing from.
APPL_DB has it, ASIC_DB does not → orchagent rejected it (show logging orchagent).
ASIC_DB has it, hardware does not → syncd/SAI failed (docker logs syncd).
